title: Classical Arched Villa — Muskan Agrawal
tagline: G+2 neoclassical manor with stepped crown parapet, arched central loggias, and architectural CAD front elevation
description: A grand multi-tier neoclassical residence in Raipur featuring a stepped pyramid rooftop parapet, semicircular central loggias with arched crowning, textured travertine wall cladding, covered cantilever car portico, and complete architectural CAD elevation engineering.

details.Key Elements: Stepped Crown Parapet, Semicircular Arched Loggias, Ornate Wrought-Iron Railings, Full CAD Front Elevation
details.Sections: Section X-X & Section Y-Y Technical Detailing
